name: qkv_hub_t-v1-COMMIT
purpose: ref-flow-1011 validation (b): Qwen KV attention hub cluster over ref-flow tile views, floorplan+PDN+CTS

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN --top-module ot_qwen_nearhbm_attn_hub_t rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qwen_nearhbm_attn_hub_t.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qwen_nearhbm_attn_hub_p.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qwen_nearhbm_sfu_p.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_sfu.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat_nr.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.01 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkv_hub_t/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkv_hub_t/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkv_hub_t --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qwen_nearhbm_attn_hub_t --macro-view physical/ref_tile/nhb_pbst_ref/views/ot_nhb_pbst --macro-view physical/ref_tile/nhb_pvlg_ref/views/ot_nhb_pvlg --macro-view physical/ref_tile/nhb_zh_ref/views/ot_nhb_zh > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

no_bench_reason: flow validation through CTS only (no adoption)
